title: Zariski's Main localization at a quasi-finite prime
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a ring map of finite type [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], let $B'\subseteq B$ be the integral closure of $A$ in $B$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure], and let $\mathfrak q\subseteq B$ be a prime ideal at which $A\to B$ is quasi-finite [def-weil-pbc-ring-map-quasi-finite-at-prime] (Stacks Algebra Definition 00PL). Then there is an element $h\in B'$ with $h\notin\mathfrak q$ such that the map $B'_h\to B_h$, $y/h^n\mapsto y/h^n$, between the localizations at the powers of $h$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away] induced by the inclusion $B'\subseteq B$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: Algebra, Theorem Tag 00Q9 (theorem-main-theorem, line 30779) and its proof (lines 30788-30877); used in literature/stacks-project/more-algebra.tex:2524-2529 (proof of Lemma Tag 09XH)

proof.text: Let q be the given prime and p its contraction. The definition [def-weil-pbc-ring-map-quasi-finite-at-prime] gives an open singleton at the canonical point of Spec(κ(p) ⊗[R] S). Using PrimeSpectrum.preimageHomeomorphFiber R S p, transport this singleton to the topological fibre of Spec S → Spec R: rewrite openness by Homeomorph.isOpen_image and Set.image_singleton. Algebra.quasiFiniteAt_iff_isOpen_singleton_fiber (Mathlib/RingTheory/ZariskisMainTheorem.lean:754-764) then supplies the instance Algebra.QuasiFiniteAt R q. No extra hypothesis is introduced.

Apply Algebra.ZariskisMainProperty.of_finiteType (Mathlib/RingTheory/ZariskisMainTheorem.lean:660-663), the proved Mathlib version of Stacks Tag 00Q9. Its conclusion Algebra.ZariskisMainProperty R q unfolds by definition (lines 75-77) to precisely an h in the integral closure [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure], outside q, whose canonical awayMap between the principal localizations [def-weil-ring-localization-away] is bijective.

proof_origin.place: Algebra.ZariskisMainProperty.of_finiteType and Algebra.quasiFiniteAt_iff_isOpen_singleton_fiber; direct application after transporting openness through PrimeSpectrum.preimageHomeomorphFiber. Mathlib proves Stacks Tag 00Q9.
